rtu_frame_waveform.frame_layout: Address (1 B) | Function Code (1 B) | Data (0..252 B) | CRC-Lo (1 B) | CRC-Hi (1 B) — total ≤ 256 B.
rtu_frame_waveform.start_of_frame: First bit of the first byte after ≥ T3.5 silent line. Implementations detect frame start by leaving the T3.5 silent state.
rtu_frame_waveform.byte_transmission: Each byte sent on the underlying UART as 1 start bit + 8 data bits LSB-first + parity (default: even) + 1 stop bit (or 2 stop bits if no parity).
rtu_frame_waveform.inter_character_gap_intra_frame: Up to T1.5 character times of silence allowed between consecutive bytes of the same frame.
rtu_frame_waveform.end_of_frame_silence: ≥ T3.5 character times of silent line after the last byte signals end-of-frame and re-enables reception.
rtu_frame_waveform.T_3p5_at_19200: ≈ 2.0 ms (per spec; minimum fixed value 1.75 ms recommended above 19200 baud)
rtu_frame_waveform.wire_polarity: Idle line = mark (UART idle HIGH); start bit = space (LOW).

ascii_frame_waveform.start_of_frame: ':' (0x3A) — single ASCII character. Receiver finds frame start by scanning for ':' on the line.
ascii_frame_waveform.address: 2 ASCII-hex characters (A2, A1) representing 1 binary byte (high nibble first).
ascii_frame_waveform.function_code: 2 ASCII-hex characters representing the 1-byte function code.
ascii_frame_waveform.data: 2N ASCII-hex characters representing the N-byte PDU data.
ascii_frame_waveform.lrc: 2 ASCII-hex characters representing the 1-byte Longitudinal Redundancy Check.
ascii_frame_waveform.ascii_chars_only: Allowed characters between SOF and EOF: 0-9, A-F (upper-case is standard; some implementations accept lower-case).

tcp_frame_waveform.mbap_header: Transaction ID (2 B) | Protocol ID (2 B = 0x0000) | Length (2 B) | Unit ID (1 B) — 7 bytes total.
tcp_frame_waveform.pdu_payload: Function Code (1 B) + Data (0..252 B), immediately after the MBAP header.
tcp_frame_waveform.length_field: MBAP.Length = 1 + len(PDU); excludes the first 6 bytes of the MBAP header itself.
tcp_frame_waveform.no_extra_crc: MODBUS TCP has no per-PDU CRC; data integrity is provided by Ethernet CRC-32 + TCP checksum.
tcp_frame_waveform.concurrent_transactions: Client may have multiple outstanding requests on the same TCP socket by varying Transaction ID.

request_response_timing.client_request_timeout: Implementation-defined; must be set so the client does not wait indefinitely. Typical values: 100..500 ms for RTU at 9600 baud, 1..5 s for TCP across WAN.
request_response_timing.server_processing_delay: Implementation-defined; should be short enough to fit within the client timeout. Long-running programming commands return exception 0x05 ACKNOWLEDGE to prevent timeout.
request_response_timing.broadcast_no_response: On serial transports, broadcast frames (address 0) elicit no response; the client must wait T_broadcast_interval between successive broadcasts (implementation-defined, typically several T3.5 silent periods).
request_response_timing.comm_error_no_response: If the server detects parity/framing/CRC/LRC error, it sends no response; the client times out.

crc_lrc_computation_timing.rtu_crc_throughput: 1 byte / 8 cycles using a bit-serial CRC-16-Modbus engine, or 1 byte / 1 cycle using an 8-bit-parallel lookup-table or shift-register implementation.
crc_lrc_computation_timing.ascii_lrc_throughput: Two's-complement of the byte-wise sum of Address + Function + Data; trivially computed as a running 8-bit accumulator.

absolute_max_ratings.n_a_at_protocol_layer: MODBUS itself is OSI level 7; absolute maximum voltage / temperature / power ratings are determined by the chosen physical layer and implementation device (UART, Ethernet PHY, FPGA / ASIC, microcontroller).
